Description: فضای مشخص با مرز زمانی هوشمند
CalculatorCode: using System; using PhotonBypass.Domain.Static; public class Calculator { public static PriceCalculationOutput Compute(PriceCalculationInput input) { if (input.Gigabytes is not int gigabytes || gigabytes <= 0) throw new Exception("Invalid gigabytes value."); int packages = gigabytes / 25; return new PriceCalculationOutput { Price = 60 + packages * 50, Users = null, Days = (short)(60 + packages * 30) }; } }

Name: Complete
Title: کامل
CalculatorCode: using System; using PhotonBypass.Domain.Static; public class Calculator { public static PriceCalculationOutput Compute(PriceCalculationInput input) { int users = input.Users ?? 1; short days = input.Days ?? 30; int gigabytes = input.Gigabytes ?? 25; return new PriceCalculationOutput { Price = 30 + users * 5 + days * 2 + (gigabytes / 25) * 10, Users = (byte)users, Days = days, Gigabytes = gigabytes }; } }
